info.title: YouTube Transcript APIs for AI Agents
info.description: Pay-per-call YouTube transcript, captions and video-to-text APIs for autonomous AI agents. No signup required. Payment via x402 using USDC on Base. Payments settle on-chain only after a successful response.

servers.description: Bankr x402 Cloud — USDC on Base

post.summary: Get YouTube transcript with timestamps, language selection and translation
post.description: Extract clean transcript, captions or subtitles from any YouTube video URL. Supports manual/auto caption preference, language selection, optional translation, timestamped segments and JSON/text/SRT output. Built for RAG ingestion, LLM context, research, summarization and autonomous agent workflows.

TranscriptRequest.description: Request body for youtube-transcript (premium endpoint with translation and caption source control)

url.description: YouTube video URL (youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live)

language.description: Preferred transcript/caption language code (e.g. en, es, pt, fr)

sourcePreference.description: Caption source preference: any (default), manual (human-created), generated (auto-generated)

translateTo.description: Target language code for YouTube caption translation

includeSegments.description: Include timestamped transcript segments in output

format.description: Output format: json (default), plain text, or SRT subtitle

CaptionsRequest.description: Request body for youtube-captions and youtube-video-to-text

url.description: YouTube video URL (youtube.com/watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live)

language.description: Preferred captions/transcript language code (e.g. en, es, pt, fr)

includeSegments.description: Include timestamped caption segments in output

format.description: Output format: json (default), plain text, or SRT subtitle

success.description: Whether the transcript was extracted successfully

autoGenerated.description: Whether the captions were auto-generated by YouTube

translateTo.description: Target translation language code if translated

formatted.description: Formatted output text (plain text or SRT depending on format parameter)

wordCount.description: Number of words in the transcript

characterCount.description: Number of characters in the transcript

segments.description: Timestamped transcript segments (included when includeSegments=true or format=srt)

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transcript was fetched
